increasing the temperature of O/W emulsified cream to 30° results in increase in its stability due to the formation of liquid crystal phase below 35 °.
the increase in temperature of emulsions from 20 to 30° increases their stability.

the development of a theory to determine a storage temperature of materials obeying non- Newtonian plastic flow.
the development of a new method for determining storage temperature of pharmaceuticals and cosmetics, especially emulsions, which is based on the measurement of their zeta potential.
adjusting and resetting the predetermined O/W miconozole cream storage temperature from 20- 24° to be coincided with the storage temperature in Egypt climatic ICH zone IVa, i.e. 30°.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the storage temperature of O/ W emulsions stabilized with nonionic surfactant can be adjusted and reset to 30± 2° by changing the oil phase ingredients and their proportions.
the emulsion droplet diameter and emulsion droplet size are the best parameters to define emulsion stability.
the storage temperature of O/w emulsion is a function of HLB value of oil phase and the temperature of the emulsion.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the storage temperature of O/ W emulsions stabilized with nonionic surfactant can be adjusted and reset by adjusting the HLB of the oil phase to a value equal to the HLB of surfactants used to stabilize the emulsion.
the storage temperature of O/ W emulsions is a function of the oil phase composition and concentration.
the storage temperature of O/ W emulsions can be adjusted and reset to be equal to 30° to be in accordance with the climatic zone IV A of the Egyptian ICH/WHO.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the storage temperature of O/ W miconazole cream can be increased to 30° and that the increase in storage temperature is accompanied by increase in emulsion stability due to the formation of liquid crystal phase below 35°C.
the storage temperature of O/ W emulsions stabilized with nonionic surfactant can be adjusted and reset according to their storage temperature.

the storage temperature of O/ W emulsions stabilized with surfactants can be adjusted and reset by changing the oil phase ingredients and/or their proportions to coincide with the climatic storage temperature of the area of use.
